scripts.build: bun run --cwd web build && bun run budget && cargo build --release --locked -p kosse
scripts.check: bun run fmt:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test && cargo build --release --locked -p kosse
scripts.test: bun run --cwd web test && bun run --cwd web build && bun run budget && cargo nextest run --workspace --locked && cargo test --doc --workspace --locked
scripts.test:e2e: bun run --cwd web build && cargo build --locked -p kosse -p kosse-fixtures --bins && playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.ts
scripts.screenshots: KOSSE_SCREENSHOTS=1 bun run test:e2e e2e/screenshots.spec.ts --project webkit && oxipng -o 4 --strip safe -q -r docs/screenshots
scripts.test:package: bun run release:local && cargo build --locked -p kosse-fixtures --bins && bun scripts/package-test.ts
scripts.lint: bun run lint:web && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd web typecheck && tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p e2e
scripts.contracts: KOSSE_UPDATE_CONTRACTS=1 cargo nextest run --locked -p kosse-core --test contracts --test profile_schema
